title: Order IX Rule 13 CPC — Set aside ex parte decree

content.overview: An ex parte decree is set aside if summons was not duly served, or sufficient cause prevented appearance.
content.study: Irregular service is not enough if the defendant had real notice and time. An appeal against the ex parte decree is a parallel path under Section 96. Pick one strategy and watch limitation.
